Local changes: standalone includes/logging/memory adapters; lowercase libhat include;
missing-section check; bounded PE section-name comparisons; preserve resolved state on destruction.
No Amethyst loader, game headers or runtime dependencies are included.
Signature resolution now checks committed readable sections (executable for functions) and rejects ambiguous matches.
